description: A signed, timestamped record of current capability: which chains can actually be PAID OUT ON right now, which are merely policy-eligible, which rails are execute-ready, and whether delivery figures are measured or estimated. USE `serviceableNow`, NOT `policyEligible`, when deciding where to send funds — a chain can be eligible by policy while holding no inventory, in which case the instant lane is unavailable and the transfer falls through to a bridge rail. `notServiceable` lists the difference. Fetch this BEFORE committing to a multi-step plan and keep it with your decision: if the plan later fails you can show what you were told. It is a RECORD, not a guarantee — it does not promise the same capability a minute later, and the signature does not make it an SLA.
name: robyn_capability_snapshot
title: What Robyn can actually do right now (signed)
